claim_boundary: Static contract coverage only. No new-domain solver, candidate evaluation, LLM call, or generalization effect is claimed.

candidate_domains.feasibility_oracle: every node appears in exactly one partition
candidate_domains.dev_split_rule: seeded graph generators and public instances; hashes frozen before generation
candidate_domains.heldout_split_rule: unseen generator seeds and instance families; inaccessible to retrieval
candidate_domains.admission_reason: 引入图划分与最大化目标，检验当前路由/装箱机制是否只是表面迁移

candidate_domains.feasibility_oracle: total selected weight does not exceed capacity
candidate_domains.dev_split_rule: seeded value-weight regimes; regime labels visible only on dev
candidate_domains.heldout_split_rule: unseen correlations and capacity ratios; hashes frozen before pilot
candidate_domains.admission_reason: 与 BP 共享容量概念但解表示和离线目标不同，适合检验抽象机制迁移边界

candidate_domains.feasibility_oracle: machine non-overlap and job precedence both hold
candidate_domains.dev_split_rule: seeded job-machine-size strata with frozen instance hashes
candidate_domains.heldout_split_rule: unseen size strata and processing-time regimes; retrieval denied
candidate_domains.admission_reason: 引入先后约束与时间结构，覆盖当前三问题不具备的约束族

guardrails: same frozen provider and controller configuration across arms
no source executable code or source solution injection
no heldout retrieval before the final frozen evaluation
candidate evaluations, not generations, are the common budget unit
exit_conditions: valid candidate rate is below the no-transfer arm by more than 10 percentage points
abstract transfer does not beat shuffled transfer on at least two paired seeds
analysis confidence is uncalibrated and does not improve candidate ranking
the domain requires a second top-level controller or incomparable budget semantics
